lines: d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Brendan Keita is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d30: 🕯️ Brendan is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d30: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d30: 🕯️ Brendan Keita is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d30: What Brendan kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d30: "Brendan's gone." Shanice looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Brendan." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d30: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Nicole blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d30: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Brendan Keita, 30 days. The mantle passes to Nicole Miranda.
d30: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nicole Miranda, 20 — a Sailor. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock.
d30: The village's quarrel was with Brendan — and Brendan is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d30: At the grave, Shanice, Terrence, Monique and 2 more speak for Nicole — "Brendan trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d30: The fire knew Nicole before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
